channel.title: The Daily Mirror

item.description: It will simply reveal them.

item.description: Why did I stop going to it?

item.description: what a full chair could have.

item.description: Maybe He was simply waiting for your call.

item.description: What am I holding so tightly today... that one day I'll have to let go anyway?

item.description: Who am I today?

item.description: or the place where the right message quietly dies?

item.description: Do I value the friends who make me feel good... or the ones who help me make better decisions?

item.description: What quiet voice in my life have I stopped hearing because I've become too accustomed to the noise?

item.description: Today, what am I chasing simply because everyone else is running toward it... and have I paused long enough to ask if it's taking me where I truly want to go?

item.description: Which voice have I given permission to guide me?
